card.name: Start of an adverb ending in -ly
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that will finish as an adverb (such as -ly or -ously), right after a verb or participle. Often seen in route or manner words like intravenously, transversely, or unjustly.

modes.label: Route or manner adverbs
modes.description: A word beginning like intra-, trans-, or inter- that will become an adverb of how a drug is given or applied.
modes.example: insert CERVIDIL<< trans>>versely, in the posterior fornix

modes.label: General -ly adverbs
modes.description: The stem of an ordinary adverb after a verb, with the -ly still to come.
modes.example: they had been condemned<< unjust>>ly, and appealed to the pope.

card.writes: It favors word endings that complete adverbs, such as -ynchronously, -izontally and -uously.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of a long word that is about to end in -ly, like intra-venously or trans-versely.
